title: Pur+egex!
body: To alleviate participants' stress, Aneesh decided to host cat-petting sessions during the hackathon. People provided feedback for this event, and Aneesh is trying to process this text data.\n\nFor subparts (a) and (b) you are given a table with two columns. Your pattern MUST match every string under "Match all of these below" and must NOT match any string under "Match none of these below". For example, given case $$1$$ and case $$2$$ under "Match all" and case $$3$$ and case $$4$$ under "Match none", you provide a pattern that matches case $$1$$ and case $$2$$ but not case $$3$$ and case $$4$$.
